text: 金十数据7月13日讯，华安证券公告，预计2026年上半年净利润人民币20.70亿元至人民币22.77亿元，同比增加100%至120%。预计2026年半年度实现归属于上市公司股东的扣除非经常性损益的净利润人民币20.57亿元至人民币22.63亿元，同比增加100%至120%。报告期内，公司私募股权投资基金业务、另类投资业务、经纪业务等同比增幅较大，经营业绩创历史同期新高。
text_en: Jinshi Data July 13: Hua An Securities announced it expects net profit of RMB 2.070 billion to RMB 2.277 billion for the first half of 2026, up 100% to 120% year-on-year. It expects net profit attributable to shareholders excluding non-recurring gains and losses of RMB 2.057 billion to RMB 2.263 billion for the first half of 2026, up 100% to 120% year-on-year. During the reporting period, the company's private equity fund investment, alternative investment, and brokerage businesses saw significant year-on-year increases, with operating results reaching record highs for the period.
